units.summary: New test. It evicts a series with CompactSelectedSeries, forces a WAL checkpoint and checks that the series record is still in the checkpoint. It is test-only and adds coverage.
units.headline: New test: evicted selected series record kept in WAL checkpoint
units.reason: A new test cannot change production behavior.

units.summary: gcStaleSeries is renamed to gcSeries and now takes an eviction predicate. numStaleSeries is now reduced only by the count of deleted series that were actually stale, not by every deleted series. This fixes the counter now that non-stale series can be evicted.
units.headline: gcSeries takes eviction predicate; stale counter uses actual stale deletions
units.reason: Changes eviction logic and how the head's series metrics are accounted.
focus: numStaleSeries decrement now counts only stale series, so check it can't drift below or above the true count
all callers pass a correct shouldEvict predicate

units.summary: The hardcoded staleness check is replaced by a shouldEvict predicate that is called with the series lock held. The function also returns how many of the deleted series were stale. The stale path keeps the same behavior because its predicate includes isStaleSeries.
units.headline: Stripe GC uses caller predicate and counts stale deletions
units.reason: Generalizes which series can be deleted from the head; a reviewer must check the predicate semantics.
focus: shouldEvict runs with series lock held, which hasAppendIDAbove requires
the stale predicate still matches the old isStale check plus the new OOO and watermark guards
